fresh_repository_liveness.meaning: Legacy metrics/control-plane publication remains live after HARD_OFF; this is not itself proof of provider calls or host identity.

exact_action: On the live Clay host, use a clean checkout containing source_commit 3ad09d27a07c03de7b77e65c0c09055cbe31504a or later main with byte-identical v1/v2 attribution tools.
Do not kill or mutate any process/service/scheduler in the attribution step.

v2 is deliberately stricter than v1: MEDIUM-confidence container/tmux/screen/nohup hints are not actionable. SYSTEMD requires exactly one unit whose show/cat content binds a legacy entrypoint; CRON requires exactly one matching scheduler source/entry.
If decision is INCOMPLETE_FAIL_CLOSED_NO_KILL, perform secondary read-only attribution of the concrete owning container/session/supervisor. Do not guess.
Only if every matched root is actionable may the next step disable the exact restart authority first and then terminate only the bound Clay legacy tree descendants-first.
After disable+termination require >=90 seconds zero matched survivors, zero descendants and zero restart events before provider-gate runtime validation or GRID10 work resumes.
